# Menton with a Dog: Walks, Beaches, Transport and Practical Tips

Menton can be a wonderful place to visit with a dog. You have Mediterranean waterfront walks, a compact town centre, nearby hills and the possibility of exploring both the French and Italian Rivieras without travelling far. But there's one thing worth knowing before you arrive: Menton isn't a destination where dogs can go everywhere. Most beaches prohibit dogs, including those on a leash. Public transport has its own rules, and the requirements change when you cross into Monaco or Italy.

Fortunately, Menton also has three designated dog-friendly beach areas and three officially announced enclosed dog parks, making it possible to organise a comfortable holiday for both you and your four-legged companion. Here's what you need to know.

# Menton avec un chien : promenades, plages, transports et conseils pratiques

Menton peut être une belle destination avec un chien : promenades méditerranéennes, centre compact, collines et excursions sur les Rivieras française et italienne. Mais les animaux ne sont pas admis partout. La plupart des plages les interdisent, même tenus en laisse, et les conditions de transport changent en traversant la frontière.

La ville annonce trois secteurs de plage autorisés aux chiens et trois parcs canins clos, dont une enceinte réservée aux petits chiens. Avec quelques vérifications, vous pourrez organiser un séjour agréable sans transformer chaque sortie en problème d'accès.

# Mentone con un cane: passeggiate, spiagge, trasporti e consigli pratici

Mentone può essere una bella meta con un cane: lungomare mediterraneo, centro compatto, colline e gite sulle Riviere francese e italiana. Non significa però accesso ovunque. La maggior parte delle spiagge vieta i cani anche al guinzaglio; i trasporti hanno regole proprie e attraversando il confine cambiano le condizioni.

La città annuncia tre settori di spiaggia ammessi ai cani e tre aree canine recintate, una riservata ai cani piccoli. Preparando documenti, percorsi e alloggio è possibile organizzare una vacanza comoda per entrambi.

# Ментон із собакою: прогулянки, пляжі, транспорт і практичні поради

Ментон може стати гарним місцем для подорожі із собакою: середземноморські набережні, компактний центр, пагорби й можливість відвідати французьку та італійську Рив'єри. Проте тварин пускають не всюди. На більшості пляжів собаки заборонені навіть на повідку, транспорт має окремі правила, а після перетину кордону умови змінюються.

Місто повідомляє про три дозволені пляжні ділянки й три огороджені собачі майданчики, один із яких призначений для малих собак. Завчасна перевірка житла, документів і маршрутів допоможе спокійно відпочити обом.

## 1. Where can you walk your dog in Menton?

The most practical everyday option is the seafront. Menton's coastal promenades offer relatively straightforward walking routes without requiring a drive into the hills. But these are shared public spaces, with pedestrians, children, cyclists in permitted areas and other dogs. Keep your dog under control and use a leash in public areas unless signs explicitly permit off-leash activity.

### Promenade du Soleil

Best for: Morning and evening walks in central Menton. The waterfront promenade is one of the easiest places to establish a daily routine. It runs beside the beaches, with cafés, sea views and access to the lower town. For dogs that enjoy walking among people, it's a pleasant choice. During summer, aim for early mornings and later evenings. Exposed paving can become uncomfortably hot, and shade isn't continuous along the route.

Remember that permission to walk along the promenade doesn't mean your dog can enter the adjacent beach.

### Garavan waterfront

Best for: Longer walks and access to the eastern dog-friendly beach. The eastern waterfront around Garavan offers space for a relaxed coastal outing. It's also convenient for visitors staying towards Menton-Garavan or the Italian border. The promenade provides an alternative to walking through the busiest central shopping streets. Follow local signs around the marina and beach entrances, as access arrangements vary.

### Western Menton and the Carnolès area

Best for: Visitors staying towards Roquebrune-Cap-Martin. The western waterfront offers coastal walks and access towards the Gorbio dog-friendly beach. This can be a practical choice if you prefer not to cross the entire town each time your dog needs a longer walk.

### What about the old town?

You can explore public streets with a dog, but the upper historic centre is steep. Expect stairways, narrow passages and uneven surfaces. It's not necessarily ideal for elderly dogs, dogs with joint problems or owners who prefer level walking. For an everyday routine, the lower town and waterfront are generally more convenient.

## 1. Où promener son chien à Menton ?

Le bord de mer est généralement le plus pratique pour les sorties quotidiennes. Ces espaces restent partagés avec les piétons, les enfants, les cyclistes dans les zones autorisées et d'autres chiens. Gardez le contrôle de votre animal et la laisse, sauf autorisation explicite contraire.

### Promenade du Soleil

Pratique le matin et le soir dans le centre, elle longe les plages, les cafés et la ville basse. En été, partez tôt ou tard : les dalles chauffent et l'ombre n'est pas continue. Le droit de circuler sur la promenade n'autorise pas l'accès à la plage voisine.

### Front de mer de Garavan

Ce secteur convient aux promenades plus longues, notamment près de Menton-Garavan et de la frontière. Il permet d'éviter certaines rues commerçantes centrales et de rejoindre le secteur canin oriental. Respectez les panneaux aux entrées des plages et autour du port.

### Ouest de Menton et Carnolès

Pour un séjour vers Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, le front de mer occidental permet de marcher près de chez soi et de rejoindre le secteur canin du Gorbio sans traverser toute la ville.

### Et la vieille ville ?

Les rues publiques peuvent se visiter avec un chien, mais le haut du centre historique comporte pentes, escaliers, passages étroits et sols irréguliers. Pour un chien âgé ou souffrant des articulations, privilégiez la ville basse et le littoral au quotidien.

## 1. Dove passeggiare con il cane a Mentone?

Il lungomare è spesso la soluzione quotidiana più pratica, senza dover raggiungere le colline in auto. È uno spazio condiviso con pedoni, bambini, ciclisti nei tratti consentiti e altri animali. Mantieni il controllo e usa il guinzaglio, salvo autorizzazione esplicita contraria.

### Promenade du Soleil

Comoda per mattine e sere nel centro, costeggia spiagge, caffè e città bassa. Per i cani abituati alla gente può diventare una buona routine. In estate esci presto o tardi: la pavimentazione scotta e l'ombra non è continua. Camminare sulla passeggiata non autorizza l'accesso alla spiaggia adiacente.

### Lungomare di Garavan

Adatto a uscite più lunghe verso Menton-Garavan e il confine, permette di evitare alcune vie commerciali affollate e raggiungere il settore canino orientale. Segui i cartelli intorno al porto e agli ingressi delle spiagge: le condizioni possono cambiare.

### Mentone occidentale e Carnolès

Per chi soggiorna verso Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, il tratto occidentale offre passeggiate vicine e accesso al settore canino del Gorbio, senza attraversare tutta la città a ogni uscita.

### Il centro storico

Le strade pubbliche si possono esplorare con il cane, ma la parte alta presenta pendenze, scale, vicoli stretti e superfici irregolari. Per animali anziani o con problemi articolari, città bassa e lungomare sono generalmente più comodi nella routine quotidiana.

## 1. Де гуляти із собакою в Ментоні?

Для щоденних виходів найзручнішим часто є узбережжя: не потрібно щоразу їхати в гори. Це спільний простір із пішоходами, дітьми, велосипедистами на дозволених ділянках та іншими собаками. Контролюйте тварину й користуйтеся повідком, якщо знаки прямо не дозволяють інше.

### Promenade du Soleil

Зручна для ранку й вечора в центрі: поруч пляжі, кафе та нижнє місто. Собака, звикла до людей, може швидко освоїти цей маршрут. Улітку виходьте раніше або пізніше: покриття нагрівається, суцільної тіні немає. Дозвіл гуляти набережною не означає права вийти на сусідній пляж.

### Узбережжя Garavan

Підходить для довших виходів біля Menton-Garavan та італійського кордону. Тут можна уникнути частини найлюдніших торгових вулиць і дістатися східної собачої пляжної ділянки. Дивіться на знаки біля порту та входів на пляжі: доступ не всюди однаковий.

### Захід Ментона й Carnolès

Якщо живете ближче до Рокбрюн-Кап-Мартен, західне узбережжя дає щоденні прогулянки поблизу й доступ до собачої ділянки Gorbio без потреби перетинати все місто.

### А старе місто?

Публічними вулицями можна пройти із собакою, але верхній історичний центр має схили, сходи, вузькі проходи й нерівне покриття. Для літніх тварин або собак із проблемами суглобів нижнє місто та набережна зазвичай зручніші для повсякденного режиму.

## 2. Dog-friendly beaches in Menton: the 2026 rules

This is probably the most important section of the guide. On 29 April 2026, the City of Menton reaffirmed that three designated beaches welcome dogs. These are:

| Beach | Location | Practical notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Plage du Gorbio | Western Menton, near the Roquebrune-Cap-Martin boundary | Useful for visitors staying in the western part of town |
| Plage du Casino | Central Menton, near the Casino Barrière area | Convenient for a central seafront walk |
| Plage Hawaï | Eastern Menton, Garavan | Dedicated dog-friendly area near the Italian side |

The municipality states that dog-friendly beach areas are marked with signs and identifying flags. Stay within the designated boundaries, not simply on any part of a beach with the same name.

### Are these beaches open to dogs all year?

The city's April 2026 notice confirms the three designated areas. A blanket year-round permission for every part of these beaches was not independently verified for this review. Because municipal restrictions can be amended, use the latest signs and city notices as the authority for your particular visit. Don't assume a winter exemption exists for beaches where dogs are otherwise prohibited.

### Can dogs swim?

At designated dog beaches, check the posted bathing conditions. The tourism office describes the dog beach on Promenade Reine Astrid as having showers and warns that bathing isn't supervised. Dog access doesn't guarantee a lifeguard service, calm water or safe swimming conditions. Avoid letting your dog swim during rough seas, storms, pollution warnings or other unsafe conditions. Rinse salt water from your dog's coat after swimming, and provide fresh drinking water.

### What about Les Sablettes and the other beaches?

Unless a section is explicitly designated for dogs, don't take your dog onto the beach, even on a leash. This includes popular beaches such as Les Sablettes, Fossan and other non-designated areas. The municipality has warned that violations can result in fines. For current regulations, consult the [City of Menton's official dog beach notice](https://www.menton.fr/chiens-sur-les-plages-de-menton-rappel-des-regles-en-vigueur.html).

## 2. Plages autorisées aux chiens : les règles de 2026

Le 29 avril 2026, la Ville de Menton a rappelé l'existence de trois secteurs autorisés.

| Plage | Situation | Conseil |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Plage du Gorbio | Ouest, limite avec Roquebrune-Cap-Martin | Pratique depuis les quartiers occidentaux |
| Plage du Casino | Centre, près du Casino Barrière | À intégrer à une promenade centrale |
| Plage Hawaï | Est, Garavan | Secteur canin du côté italien |

Les secteurs sont signalés par panneaux et fanions. Restez dans ces limites : le nom d'une plage ne signifie pas que toute sa surface accepte les chiens.

### Toute l'année ?

Le rappel municipal d'avril confirme les trois secteurs, mais cette vérification n'a pas établi une autorisation générale annuelle pour toute leur étendue. Les panneaux et arrêtés actuels font foi. Ne supposez pas qu'une plage interdite devient autorisée en hiver.

### Baignade

L'office de tourisme indique des douches sur la plage des chiens de la promenade Reine Astrid et précise que la baignade n'est pas surveillée. Accès autorisé ne signifie ni présence de sauveteur ni mer calme. Évitez tempêtes, forte houle et alertes de pollution ; prévoyez de l'eau douce et rincez le pelage après la mer.

### Sablettes et autres plages

Les secteurs ordinaires des Sablettes, du Fossan et des autres plages non désignées ne sont pas autorisés, même en laisse. La mairie rappelle le risque d'amende.

[Ville de Menton : règles des plages](https://www.menton.fr/chiens-sur-les-plages-de-menton-rappel-des-regles-en-vigueur.html)

## 2. Spiagge ammesse ai cani: le regole del 2026

Il 29 aprile 2026 il Comune di Mentone ha ricordato i tre settori autorizzati.

| Spiaggia | Posizione | Indicazione pratica |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Plage du Gorbio | Ovest, confine con Roquebrune-Cap-Martin | Comoda dai quartieri occidentali |
| Plage du Casino | Centro, vicino al Casino Barrière | Da abbinare alla passeggiata centrale |
| Plage Hawaï | Est, Garavan | Settore canino verso l'Italia |

Le aree sono delimitate da cartelli e bandierine. Resta all'interno dei confini: il nome della spiaggia non rende accessibile tutta la sua superficie.

### Tutto l'anno?

L'avviso di aprile conferma i tre settori, ma questa verifica non ha stabilito un'autorizzazione annuale generale per ogni loro parte. Fanno fede cartelli e disposizioni attuali. Non presumere che una spiaggia vietata diventi libera per i cani in inverno.

### Bagno in mare

L'ufficio turistico segnala docce sulla spiaggia dei cani della Promenade Reine Astrid e precisa che la balneazione non è sorvegliata. L'accesso non garantisce bagnini, mare calmo o acqua sicura. Evita mareggiate, temporali e avvisi d'inquinamento; porta acqua dolce da bere e sciacqua il pelo dopo il bagno.

### Sablettes e altre spiagge

Le normali zone di Les Sablettes, Fossan e le altre spiagge non designate non ammettono i cani, neppure al guinzaglio. Il Comune ricorda la possibilità di sanzioni.

[Comune di Mentone: regole delle spiagge](https://www.menton.fr/chiens-sur-les-plages-de-menton-rappel-des-regles-en-vigueur.html)

## 2. Пляжі для собак: правила 2026 року

29 квітня 2026 року мерія Ментона нагадала про три дозволені ділянки.

| Пляж | Розташування | Практично |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Plage du Gorbio | Захід, межа з Рокбрюн-Кап-Мартен | Зручно із західних кварталів |
| Plage du Casino | Центр, біля Casino Barrière | Поєднується з центральною прогулянкою |
| Plage Hawaï | Схід, Garavan | Собача ділянка з італійського боку |

Ділянки позначені знаками й прапорцями. Залишайтеся в цих межах: назва пляжу не робить усю його територію дозволеною для собак.

### Цілий рік?

Квітневе повідомлення підтверджує три ділянки, проте під час цієї перевірки не встановлено загального цілорічного дозволу для кожної їхньої частини. Керуйтеся чинними знаками й розпорядженнями. Не вважайте, що заборонений пляж автоматично стає доступним узимку.

### Купання

Туристичний офіс повідомляє про душі на собачому пляжі Promenade Reine Astrid і попереджає, що купання без нагляду рятувальників. Дозволений доступ не гарантує спокійного моря чи безпечної води. Уникайте шторму, сильних хвиль та попереджень про забруднення; беріть прісну питну воду й змивайте сіль із шерсті після моря.

### Sablettes та інші пляжі

Звичайні ділянки Les Sablettes, Fossan та інших невизначених пляжів не дозволені навіть із повідком. Мерія нагадує про можливі штрафи.

[Мерія Ментона: пляжні правила](https://www.menton.fr/chiens-sur-les-plages-de-menton-rappel-des-regles-en-vigueur.html)

## 3. Menton's enclosed dog parks: three official locations

For dogs that need space to play, the municipal facilities overview lists two enclosed areas. A separate official notice dated 30 November 2023 announces a third at the main entrance to Parc du Pian, specifically for small dogs under 10 kg. The overview has not been fully aligned with that announcement. These are particularly valuable because public promenades aren't appropriate places to let a dog run freely.

| Dog park | Address | Facilities |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Garavan dog park | 10 Avenue Blasco Ibáñez, Menton | Enclosed area and water point |
| Serres de la Madone dog park | 115 Corniche des Serres de la Madone, Menton | Enclosed area and water point |
| Pian small-dog park | Main entrance to Parc du Pian, Menton | 220 m² enclosure for dogs under 10 kg; fountain and waste facilities announced |

According to the City of Menton, both parks are designed to let dogs socialise and exercise in a secure fenced space.

### Which one should you choose?

The Garavan location is likely more practical if you're staying on the eastern side of Menton. The Serres de la Madone location may be useful if you're staying in the hillside neighbourhoods, although its approach can involve gradients. The municipality confirms the existence and facilities of both parks but doesn't provide a full current inspection report on ground surfaces, operating hours or separate enclosures for different dog sizes.

The Pian inauguration notice published winter hours of 08:00–18:00 and summer hours of 08:00–20:00 in 2023. These are historical published hours, not a current gate inspection. Confirm current access, size restrictions, water availability and posted rules for all three parks on arrival.

[City of Menton: Third Dog Park at Pian](https://www.menton.fr/inauguration-d-un-3e-parc-a-chiens.html)

### Dog park etiquette

Even in an enclosed area, supervise your dog. Don't enter if your dog is likely to react aggressively to unfamiliar animals. Avoid bringing toys or food that could provoke conflict, and collect your dog's waste. Keep a leash available for entering and leaving. Official information: [City of Menton: Facilities for Dog Owners](https://www.menton.fr/Installations-pour-les-proprietaires-de-chiens).

## 3. Parcs canins clos : trois lieux officiellement annoncés

La page générale des équipements municipaux présente deux parcs. Une annonce distincte du 30 novembre 2023 confirme un troisième à l'entrée principale du Parc du Pian, réservé aux petits chiens de moins de 10 kg. Les deux pages ne sont donc pas entièrement harmonisées.

| Parc canin | Adresse | Équipements annoncés |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Garavan | 10 avenue Blasco Ibáñez, Menton | Enceinte et point d'eau |
| Serres de la Madone | 115 corniche des Serres de la Madone, Menton | Enceinte et point d'eau |
| Pian, petits chiens | Entrée principale du Parc du Pian, Menton | 220 m², chiens de moins de 10 kg, fontaine et équipements de propreté |

Garavan convient surtout à l'est ; Serres de la Madone peut être utile depuis les quartiers en hauteur, mais l'approche comporte des pentes. L'annonce du Pian indiquait en 2023 une ouverture de 8 h à 18 h en hiver et de 8 h à 20 h en été : ce sont des horaires historiques publiés, pas une inspection actuelle des portails.

Vérifiez sur place l'ouverture, le fonctionnement de l'eau, les tailles admises et le règlement. Les sources ne constituent pas un état actuel du sol ou des clôtures. Surveillez votre chien, évitez les rencontres s'il réagit mal, rangez nourriture et jouets pouvant provoquer des conflits, ramassez et gardez la laisse pour l'entrée et la sortie.

## 5. How to organise daily life in an apartment with a dog

An apartment can be a very comfortable option for a longer stay with a dog. You'll have more freedom to maintain your pet's normal feeding schedule, store food and organise regular walks. But not every apartment accepts animals. This guide does not certify any AzurMenton apartment as accepting dogs: obtain explicit confirmation for the specific property, animal and stay before booking.

### Before booking, ask these questions

- Are dogs accepted, and is there a size or number limit?

- Is there an additional pet fee or deposit?

- Are pets allowed to remain alone in the apartment?

- Is there a lift if the apartment is above ground level?

- Is the balcony or terrace secure?

- Where is the nearest permitted walking area?

- Are there house rules about furniture, cleaning or noise?

- Is there an appropriate place to wash or dry your dog's paws after beach visits?

Don't assume a listing marked “pet-friendly” means there are no restrictions. For example, a property may accept one small dog but not two large dogs.

### What should you bring?

Pack the essentials your dog already uses at home: regular food, bowls, medication, leash, harness, waste bags and bedding. A familiar blanket can help a dog settle into a new environment. During summer, bring a portable water bowl and consider a cooling mat if your dog struggles with heat. For longer stays, identify a nearby pet supply shop or supermarket that stocks your usual food.

Changing food abruptly during travel may cause digestive problems, so bringing a supply for the first several days is sensible.

### Leaving a dog alone

Some dogs are comfortable being alone in a familiar home but become anxious in a new apartment. Avoid leaving your dog for long periods immediately after arrival. Check the property's rules, and be considerate of neighbours. Persistent barking can create problems in residential buildings. If you plan a museum visit or another activity where dogs aren't permitted, arrange suitable care rather than assuming your dog can remain unattended all day.

## 5. Organiser la vie en appartement avec un chien

Un appartement facilite repas habituels, stockage des aliments et sorties régulières, surtout pour un long séjour. Mais tous les logements n'acceptent pas les animaux. Ce guide ne certifie aucun appartement AzurMenton comme acceptant les chiens : obtenez un accord pour le logement, l'animal et les dates précis avant de réserver.

### Questions avant réservation

- Les chiens sont-ils admis ? Quelles limites de taille ou de nombre ?
- Y a-t-il supplément ou caution ?
- L'animal peut-il rester seul ?
- Un ascenseur dessert-il le logement ?
- Balcon ou terrasse sont-ils sécurisés ?
- Où se trouve la promenade autorisée la plus proche ?
- Quelles règles concernent mobilier, nettoyage et bruit ?
- Où nettoyer et sécher les pattes après la plage ?

Une mention « animaux acceptés » peut ne concerner qu'un petit chien. Apportez nourriture habituelle, gamelles, médicaments prescrits, laisse, harnais, sacs et couchage ; une couverture familière aide à s'installer. En été, prévoyez une gamelle portable et, si adapté, un tapis rafraîchissant. Repérez les commerces pour un séjour long et gardez quelques jours de nourriture habituelle afin d'éviter un changement brutal.

### Laisser son chien seul

Un animal calme à domicile peut devenir anxieux dans un logement inconnu. Ne le laissez pas longtemps seul dès l'arrivée. Respectez le règlement et les voisins : les aboiements persistants gênent dans un immeuble. Pour un musée ou une activité interdite aux chiens, organisez une garde adaptée plutôt qu'une journée entière sans surveillance.

## 5. Vita quotidiana in appartamento con un cane

Un appartamento facilita alimentazione abituale, conservazione del cibo e passeggiate regolari, soprattutto nei soggiorni lunghi. Non tutti accettano animali. Questa guida non certifica alcun appartamento AzurMenton come adatto ai cani: ottieni conferma esplicita per l'alloggio, l'animale e le date prima di prenotare.

### Domande prima della prenotazione

- Sono ammessi cani? Quali limiti di numero o taglia?
- Supplemento o deposito aggiuntivo?
- Il cane può restare solo?
- C'è un ascensore ai piani superiori?
- Balcone e terrazza sono sicuri?
- Qual è la passeggiata consentita più vicina?
- Quali regole riguardano arredi, pulizia e rumore?
- Dove lavare e asciugare le zampe dopo la spiaggia?

«Animali ammessi» può significare un solo cane piccolo, non due grandi. Porta cibo abituale, ciotole, farmaci prescritti, guinzaglio, pettorina, sacchetti e cuccia; una coperta familiare aiuta. In estate servono ciotola portatile e, se adatto, tappetino rinfrescante. Per soggiorni lunghi individua negozi e supermercati e mantieni una scorta iniziale, evitando cambi alimentari improvvisi.

### Lasciarlo solo

Un cane tranquillo a casa può diventare ansioso in un luogo sconosciuto. Evita lunghe assenze appena arrivato, rispetta il regolamento e i vicini: abbaiare continuamente crea problemi in condominio. Per musei o attività vietate ai cani organizza una custodia adeguata, senza dare per scontata un'intera giornata da solo.

## 5. Побут в апартаментах із собакою

Апартаменти полегшують звичне харчування, зберігання корму й регулярні виходи, особливо під час тривалого перебування. Але тварин приймають не всюди. Цей гід не підтверджує, що будь-які апартаменти AzurMenton приймають собак: до бронювання отримайте пряму згоду щодо конкретного житла, тварини й дат.

### Що запитати до бронювання

- Чи дозволені собаки? Які обмеження за кількістю та розміром?
- Чи потрібні доплата або депозит?
- Чи може собака залишатися сама?
- Чи є ліфт на потрібний поверх?
- Чи безпечні балкон або тераса?
- Де найближче дозволене місце прогулянки?
- Які правила щодо меблів, прибирання й шуму?
- Де мити й сушити лапи після пляжу?

Позначка «з тваринами» може означати лише одного малого собаку, а не двох великих. Візьміть звичний корм, миски, призначені ліки, повідець, шлею, пакети й лежанку; знайома ковдра допомагає освоїтися. Улітку корисні переносна миска та, якщо підходить тварині, охолоджувальний килимок. Для довгого проживання знайдіть магазини й майте початковий запас корму, щоб уникнути різкого переходу.

### Залишати саму

Спокійна вдома собака може тривожитися в незнайомому житлі. Не починайте з тривалих відсутностей. Поважайте правила й сусідів: постійний гавкіт заважає в житловому будинку. Для музею або іншого місця, де собаки заборонені, організуйте догляд, а не припускайте, що тварина може залишитися без нагляду весь день.

## 6. Visiting restaurants and cafés with a dog

Many cafés and restaurants in France accept well-behaved dogs, particularly on outdoor terraces. But permission is decided by the individual establishment. Always ask before entering. A simple phrase is: “Bonjour, est-ce que les chiens sont acceptés ?” That means: “Hello, are dogs allowed?” For indoor dining, ask whether your dog can remain beside your table without obstructing staff or other customers. Keep your dog on the floor rather than on a dining chair, unless the establishment explicitly permits otherwise.

During busy summer evenings, booking a terrace table can be more comfortable for everyone. For dogs sensitive to noise or crowds, a quieter lunch may be preferable to a busy dinner.

Certains établissements acceptent volontiers les chiens calmes, surtout en terrasse, mais la décision leur appartient. Demandez toujours : « Bonjour, est-ce que les chiens sont acceptés ? »

À l'intérieur, vérifiez que l'animal peut rester près de votre table sans gêner le service. Gardez-le au sol, pas sur une chaise sauf autorisation expresse. Une terrasse réservée peut faciliter une soirée estivale ; pour un chien sensible au bruit, un déjeuner calme est parfois préférable. Aucune admission générale n'est garantie.

## 7. Travelling by train with a dog: Monaco, Nice and Ventimiglia

One of Menton's greatest advantages is its coastal railway connection. You can take day trips without renting a car, but your dog needs to travel under the operator's conditions.

### TER trains within the French Riviera

SNCF TER Sud currently offers a €5 animal ticket for eligible TER/ZOU! journeys within the region. The ticket is separate from your own travel ticket. Small pets travelling in suitable closed carriers and dogs travelling on a leash with the required muzzle are covered by the relevant rules. Guide and assistance dogs have separate exemptions.

The operator specifies that each animal needs a ticket, and owners are responsible for their behaviour. Replacement coaches are more restrictive: the published TER Sud conditions admit only small animals in closed carriers and guide dogs. Regulated dog categories may be excluded; check eligibility before buying.

### What about a trip to Ventimiglia?

Ventimiglia is just across the Italian border. Don't assume that a regional pet ticket valid within France automatically covers the entire international journey. Check the operator and pet fare for the actual service you intend to board. For cross-border services, confirm the ticket conditions with SNCF or Trenitalia before departure.

### When travelling with a larger dog

Carry a suitable muzzle, even if your dog rarely wears one at home. Many train services require it, and staff may ask you to use it. Allow your dog to become familiar with the muzzle before travelling rather than introducing it for the first time at a busy station. For current fares, consult [SNCF TER Sud's animal travel page](https://www.ter.sncf.com/sud-provence-alpes-cote-d-azur/tarifs-cartes/tarifs-speciaux/forfait-animal-regionsud).

Le chemin de fer côtier permet des excursions sans voiture, sous réserve des règles de l'opérateur.

Ne supposez pas que le billet régional français couvre automatiquement tout le parcours international. Confirmez opérateur, tarif animal et conditions du train choisi auprès de SNCF ou Trenitalia. ## 7. In treno con il cane: Monaco, Nizza e Ventimiglia

La ferrovia costiera permette gite senza auto, ma valgono le condizioni dell'operatore.

### TER Sud

TER Sud pubblica un biglietto animale da 5 € per viaggi TER/ZOU! idonei all'interno della regione. È separato dal biglietto del viaggiatore e ogni animale deve avere il proprio. Le condizioni dei bus sostitutivi sono più restrittive: ammettono soltanto piccoli animali in contenitori chiusi e cani guida. Alcune categorie regolamentate sono escluse: controlla l'idoneità prima di comprare. Il proprietario resta responsabile del comportamento.

### Fino a Ventimiglia

Non presumere che il biglietto regionale francese copra tutto il percorso internazionale. Verifica operatore, tariffa e condizioni del servizio preciso con SNCF o Trenitalia. Porta una museruola adatta e abitua il cane prima del viaggio, non per la prima volta in una stazione affollata.

## 7. Поїздом із собакою: Монако, Ніцца й Вентимілья

Прибережна залізниця дозволяє подорожувати без автомобіля, але діють умови перевізника.

### TER Sud

TER Sud публікує квиток для тварини за 5 € на відповідні поїздки TER/ZOU! усередині регіону. Він окремий від квитка людини, потрібен кожній тварині. Малі тварини — у відповідній закритій переносці; інші собаки — на повідку й у наморднику згідно з умовами. Для собак-поводирів і допомоги є окремі винятки.

Автобуси замість поїздів мають суворіші умови: опубліковані правила допускають лише малих тварин у закритих переносках і собак-поводирів. Деякі регульовані категорії виключені: перевіряйте право проїзду до купівлі. Власник відповідає за поведінку.

### До Вентимільї

Не вважайте, що французький регіональний квиток автоматично покриває весь міжнародний шлях. Уточнюйте оператора, тариф і правила конкретного рейсу в SNCF або Trenitalia. Майте відповідний намордник і привчайте до нього заздалегідь, не вперше на людній станції.

## 8. Local buses in Menton and Monaco

### Zest buses in Menton

The Zest network serves Menton and surrounding communities. However, a current authoritative and sufficiently detailed public pet policy covering dog size, carriers, muzzles and fares could not be independently confirmed for this guide. Contact Zest before planning a bus journey with your dog, particularly if you have a medium-sized or large dog. Ask whether your specific route permits the animal, whether a muzzle is required and whether an additional ticket must be purchased. Don't assume SNCF's €5 pet fare applies to local buses.

Monaco's public bus operator, Compagnie des Autobus de Monaco, publishes clearer rules. ## 9. Visiting Monaco with your dog

Monaco makes an appealing day trip from Menton. The country is compact, and many outdoor streets and promenades are pleasant to explore. However, Monaco has its own public-space rules.

### What to remember

Monaco law requires dogs to be leashed and supervised in public spaces and shared residential areas. First-category dogs may not be introduced or imported into Monaco; other regulated categories have additional requirements.

[Monaco: Law 1.351 on Dogs](https://legimonaco.mc/tnc/loi/2008/10-28-1.351)

Carry a muzzle if your dog's size or category makes it necessary, especially for public transport. Check individual parks, gardens, museums and restaurant policies before entering. Don't assume Monaco's beaches accept dogs simply because Menton has designated dog beaches. The easiest approach is to plan an outdoor walking itinerary with plenty of breaks and check any specific attraction before travelling.

### What documents do you need?

Although Monaco isn't an EU member, it is treated similarly to certain European countries for relevant non-commercial pet movement requirements. Carry your dog's identification and valid travel documents. A valid EU pet passport and current rabies vaccination are the practical starting point for EU-based travellers. Specific rules may differ for dogs arriving from outside the EU or belonging to regulated categories.

## 10. Taking your dog across the Italian border

A day trip from Menton to Ventimiglia can be very enjoyable with a dog. Italian cafés, markets and coastal walks offer a change of scenery without a long journey. But crossing the border doesn't mean your responsibilities disappear.

### Travel documents

For ordinary non-commercial travel between France and Italy, your dog generally needs:

- A compliant microchip, or a readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011.

- A valid EU pet passport for EU-resident animals; non-EU arrivals need the documents applicable to their origin and route.

- A valid rabies vaccination.

The microchip must normally have been implanted before the rabies vaccination. After a first valid rabies vaccination, a waiting period of at least 21 days applies. A booster administered before the previous vaccination expires normally preserves continuity. France and Italy don't generally permit entry of puppies that are too young to have fully valid rabies protection.

### Italian public-space rules

Keep your dog on a suitable leash in public places. Carry a muzzle and follow local requirements. Individual beaches may be reserved for dogs or prohibited to them. Ventimiglia's municipal animal welfare regulation explicitly provides for designated dog-friendly beach sections and prohibits access to other public beach areas. Don't assume that any Italian beach is dog-friendly outside summer. Check signs and current municipal rules. This review did not verify a specific currently operating dog beach in Ventimiglia.

[Ventimiglia: Municipal Animal Welfare Regulation](https://www.comune.ventimiglia.im.it/fr-fr/amministrazione/regolamenti/reg-dett/regolamento-per-la-tutela-ed-il-benessere-degli-animali-30607-1-ff34545703ee6cbad3136fa14aef4b00)

### Italian trains

Trenitalia generally permits small pets to travel free in suitable carriers measuring no more than 70 × 30 × 50 cm. Larger dogs may travel on eligible services with a pet ticket, leash and muzzle. On regional services, the standard larger-dog fare is generally 50% of the corresponding second-class fare, subject to the applicable offer and service conditions. Some services or replacement buses have additional restrictions. Consult [Trenitalia's official pet travel guide and Regional fare conditions](https://www.trenitalia.com/it/servizi/trasporto-animali-domestici.html).

## 11. Bringing a dog to France from another country

If you're arriving from another EU country, the standard non-commercial pet travel requirements generally include a microchip, EU pet passport and valid rabies vaccination. If you're coming from the United Kingdom, United States, Ukraine or another non-EU country, the documentation may be different. Depending on the country of origin, your dog may need an EU animal health certificate and possibly a rabies antibody test. Some countries have additional conditions related to previous vaccinations and the timing of veterinary examinations.

The requirements must be met before travel, not after arrival in Menton.

### Important rules to understand

A puppy cannot simply travel because it has been microchipped. Rabies vaccination has minimum-age requirements and a waiting period. If a booster has been allowed to expire, the waiting period may apply again. Certain French legal categories of dogs face import restrictions, mandatory leashes, muzzles or additional documentation. For dogs in regulated categories, verify eligibility before booking your trip. The authoritative sources are the [European Union's pet travel guidance](https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/travel/carry/pets-and-other-animals/index_en.htm) and [French Customs](https://www.douane.gouv.fr/fiche/travel-coming-france-your-pet).

| Winter | Cooler weather, shorter days, occasional heavy rain | Walk during daylight and avoid unsafe coastal conditions |
| Spring | Longer walks, vegetation and parasites | Maintain appropriate parasite prevention and check for ticks |
| Summer | Hot pavements, direct sun and dehydration | Walk early or late; carry water; avoid midday exertion |
| Autumn | Rainstorms, slippery surfaces and changing sea conditions | Keep routes flexible and follow weather warnings |

### Summer deserves particular attention

During a Mediterranean heatwave, a dog can become dangerously overheated even when its owner feels comfortable. Avoid leaving your dog in a parked car, including for a short errand. Check the pavement temperature before a long walk. Provide shade and fresh water. Flat-faced breeds, older dogs and dogs with medical conditions can be especially vulnerable. Dog-friendly beaches shouldn't be treated as guaranteed safe exercise areas during the hottest part of the day.

### Parasites and plants

Ask your veterinarian about appropriate prevention for ticks, fleas and sandflies in southern France and the wider Mediterranean region. Certain local parasites and infections may be unfamiliar to visitors from northern Europe. If your dog explores gardens or countryside, also be alert to processionary caterpillars, particularly during their active periods. Contact with their irritating hairs can cause serious injury.

Don't allow your dog to sniff, lick or play with caterpillars or their nests. Suspected contact needs urgent veterinary advice. This is travel information, not a diagnosis or treatment plan.

### Chaleur estivale

Ne laissez jamais le chien dans une voiture stationnée, même brièvement. Vérifiez la température du sol, prévoyez ombre et eau, évitez l'effort à midi. Demandez au vétérinaire la prévention adaptée aux tiques, puces et phlébotomes du sud de la France et de la Méditerranée, sans improviser traitement ou dosage. Évitez tout contact avec les chenilles processionnaires et leurs nids : leurs poils peuvent provoquer des lésions graves. En cas d'exposition suspectée, demandez rapidement un avis vétérinaire. ## 13. Stagioni: caldo, pioggia e passeggiate invernali

Adatta la routine al tempo reale, non all'idea di un clima sempre mite.

| --- | --- | --- |
| Inverno | Giornate corte e piogge forti | Uscire con luce ed evitare coste pericolose |
| Primavera | Vegetazione e parassiti | Prevenzione veterinaria e controllo zecche |

| Autunno | Temporali, superfici scivolose e mare variabile | Programma flessibile e allerte meteo |

### Caldo estivo

Non lasciare mai il cane nell'auto parcheggiata, neanche per poco. Controlla il pavimento, cerca ombra e acqua fresca, evita sforzi a mezzogiorno. Cani anziani, malati o brachicefali possono essere più vulnerabili. Una spiaggia canina non è automaticamente un posto sicuro per fare esercizio nelle ore calde.

### Parassiti e processionarie

Chiedi al veterinario la prevenzione adatta a zecche, pulci e flebotomi del Mediterraneo, senza improvvisare farmaci o dosi. Evita contatti con processionarie e nidi: i peli urticanti possono causare lesioni gravi. Se sospetti un'esposizione, chiedi subito consiglio veterinario. Questa è informazione di viaggio, non diagnosi o protocollo terapeutico.

## 13. Сезони: спека, дощі та зимові прогулянки

Підлаштовуйте режим під реальну погоду, а не уявлення про завжди м'який клімат.

| Сезон | На що зважати | Практичний підхід |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Зима | Короткий день і сильні дощі | Виходити засвітла, уникати небезпечного моря |
| Весна | Рослинність і паразити | Ветеринарна профілактика й огляд на кліщів |
| Літо | Гаряче покриття, сонце, зневоднення | Гуляти рано або пізно, вода й відпочинок |
| Осінь | Грози, слизькі поверхні, мінливе море | Гнучкі плани й погодні попередження |

### Літня спека

Ніколи не залишайте собаку в припаркованому авто, навіть ненадовго. Перевіряйте покриття, забезпечуйте тінь і воду, уникайте навантаження опівдні. Літні, хворі та короткоморді собаки можуть бути особливо вразливими. Собачий пляж не є автоматично безпечним місцем для активності в спеку.

### Паразити й процесійні гусениці

Запитайте ветеринара про профілактику кліщів, бліх і москітів у південній Франції та Середземномор'ї, не призначаючи самостійно ліків чи доз. Уникайте гусениць-процесіонарій та їхніх гнізд: волоски можуть спричинити важкі ушкодження. За підозри контакту терміново звертайтеся по ветеринарну пораду. Це туристична інформація, не діагноз чи схема лікування.

Spend the morning exploring Garavan. Visit the enclosed dog park on Avenue Blasco Ibáñez if it suits your dog's temperament. Continue towards the eastern waterfront and Plage Hawaï. Return for a relaxed afternoon, allowing your dog plenty of rest.

Consider Monaco or Ventimiglia. Check the train's pet conditions, carry your dog's documents and identify suitable walking areas before travelling. ## Frequently asked questions

### Is Menton dog-friendly?

Menton can be a good destination for dog owners, with seafront walks, designated dog-friendly beaches and enclosed dog parks. However, many beaches and some attractions prohibit dogs.

### Which beaches allow dogs in Menton?

The City of Menton currently lists Plage du Gorbio, Plage du Casino and Plage Hawaï. Stay within the designated areas and follow local signs.

### Can dogs go to Les Sablettes?

Dogs aren't generally permitted on the ordinary Les Sablettes beach. The beach isn't among the three designated dog-friendly areas listed by the municipality in 2026.

### Can I let my dog run off-leash in Menton?

Use an appropriate municipal enclosure under its posted rules. Official pages identify Garavan and Serres de la Madone, plus the separately announced Pian enclosure for dogs under 10 kg. Don't assume that public promenades or parks allow dogs to run free.

### Can I take my dog on a train to Nice?

Yes, subject to the SNCF operator's pet conditions. TER Sud publishes a €5 pet ticket for eligible journeys within the region, with special rules for assistance dogs.

### Can I take my dog to Monaco?

Yes, provided you comply with the applicable health, identification and local public-space rules. Monaco's bus network has separate requirements for small animals in carriers and dogs travelling on the floor.

### Can I take my dog to Ventimiglia?

Yes, provided your dog has the required documentation and complies with Italian rules. Check the specific train's conditions and local beach restrictions.

### Are there veterinarians in Menton?

Yes. Local practices include Cabinet Vétérinaire du Careï, VetoBorrigo and Iunovet. For emergencies outside normal hours, call first to confirm the appropriate service.

### Do dogs need a pet passport to travel between France and Italy?

For ordinary non-commercial travel involving an EU-resident dog, a valid EU pet passport, identification and rabies vaccination are generally required. Rules differ for some animals arriving from non-EU countries.

Menton offers plenty of opportunities for a memorable holiday with a dog. Long walks beside the Mediterranean, quiet mornings in Garavan, time in enclosed dog parks and excursions across the French and Italian borders can all become part of your stay.
